title: Te Puawānanga Science and Technology Centre
geometryBasis: The current 13-corner roof outline controls the building envelope. 2024 native LINZ 1 m surface samples constrain the shallow rising main roof, the lower eastern bay, and the southern roof transition.
sectionBasis: C3 Construction repaired and over-roofed the historic warehouse in 2023. MOTAT opened the reworked exhibition hall in 2024. The height profile follows current numerical measurements, with estimated exterior openings.
floorBasis: A native ground sample near the south approach establishes the model datum. The floor and plinth use a small positive threshold above the independent unchanged field.
limitations: The mapped footprint and sampled 2024 bare-ground and roof elevations constrain the overall profile. The location of the entrance, spacing of wall openings, southern threshold details and finish distribution are approximate.
The model uses the original Terrarium review terrain. The independent LINZ numbers constrain the roof skin and grade rise.
